t: Erbauer SDS+ 6-piece set includes a variety of drill bits, points and chisels. Designed for precision chiselling, chasing and demolition work in mortar, concrete, brickwork, tile, glazing compounds and other masonry products, as well as creating channels for pipes and conduits for electrical cables. Made from heat-treated, toughened steel and features an optimised flute design for efficient debris removal. Drill bits include enhanced carbide grade and tips for consistent performance and durability. Features shock-resistant shaft to prevent breakage during use. Supplied in a plastic storage tube and compatible with most major power tool brands.
b: Contents: 3 SDS+ Drill Bits, Point Chisel, Flat Chisel & Spade Chisel.
Suitable For Use with Breakers & SDS Hammer Drills
Suitable for Brick, Concrete, Glazing Compounds, Masonry, Mortar & Tile
Optimised Flute Design for Efficient Debris Removal
Enhanced Carbide Tips for Lasting Performance
Supplied in Durable Plastic Storage Tube
